<PAST H1:b>NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT /</PAST H1:b>
<PAST H1:c>CONDUCT POLICY</PAST H1:c>
<PAST H1:d>Recipient agrees that all information disclosed by the Company to Recipient, including without limitation information acquired by Recipient from Company employees or inspection of the Company’s property, relating to (without limitation) the Company’s products, designs, business plans, business opportunities, finances, research, development, know-how or personnel, and confidential information disclosed to the Company by third parties, shall be considered Confidential Information. </PAST H1:d><PAST H1:e>Recipient agrees to maintain the confidence of the Confidential Information and to prevent its unauthorized dissemination; provided however, that Confidential Information shall not include information which </PAST H1:e><PAST H1:f>(i) is now or subsequently becomes generally known or available by publication, commercial use or otherwise, through no fault of Recipient, </PAST H1:f><PAST H1:g>(ii) is known by Recipient at the time of disclosure, </PAST H1:g><PAST H1:h>(iii) is independently developed by Recipient without the use of any Confidential Information, </PAST H1:h><PAST H1:i>(iv) is lawfully obtained by Recipient from a third party without violation of a confidentiality obligation, or </PAST H1:i><PAST H1:j>(v) the Company agrees in writing may be disclosed by Recipient.</PAST H1:j>
<PAST H1:k>Recipient expressly agrees not to use the Confidential Information for purposes other than those necessary to consider the possibility of entering into a business relationship with the Company.</PAST H1:k>
<PAST H1:l>All Confidential Information remains the property of the Company and no license or other rights in the Confidential Information is granted hereby. </PAST H1:l><PAST H1:m>All information is provided “as is” and without any warranty, express, implied, or otherwise, regarding its accuracy or performance. </PAST H1:m><PAST H1:n>Recipient agrees to return to the Company immediately upon the Company’s written request all Confidential Information, including but not limited to all computer programs, documentation, notes, plans, drawings, and copies thereof. </PAST H1:n><PAST H1:o>Recipient agrees to comply with all United States export controls with respect to the Confidential Information.</PAST H1:o>
<PAST H1:p>Recipient hereby acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure or use of Confidential Information could cause irreparable harm and significant injury which may be difficult to ascertain. </PAST H1:p><PAST H1:q>Accordingly, Recipient agrees that the Company shall have the right to seek and obtain immediate injunctive relief from breaches of this Agreement, in addition to any other rights and remedies it may have.</PAST H1:q>
<PAST H1:r>This Agreement shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of California as they apply to contracts entered into and wholly to be performed in the State of California. </PAST H1:r><PAST H1:s>The federal and state courts within the State of California shall have exclusive jurisdiction to adjudicate any dispute arising out of this Agreement.</PAST H1:s>
<PAST H1:t>Prior to taking YOUR exam, you will be required to accept the terms and conditions of the VMware NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (NDA). </PAST H1:t><PAST H1:u>You will view the agreement on screen before the exam starts. </PAST H1:u><PAST H1:v>If you choose NOT to agree to the NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (NDA) after you select Begin Exam, your exam will be immediately cancelled and you will forfeit your exam fee.</PAST H1:v>
<PAST H1:w>BY CLICKING THE “YES, I AGREE” BUTTON ON THE EXAM ENTRY SCREEN, YOU STATE THAT YOU HAVE READ AND UNDERSTAND THIS AGREEMENT AND THAT YOU AGREE TO BE BOUND BY ITS TERMS AND CONDITIONS. </PAST H1:w><PAST H1:x>IF YOU SELECT THE "NO, I DO NOT AGREE" BUTTON, YOU WILL BE EXITED FROM THE EXAM.</PAST H1:x>
"}},"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>Annex №.1</SPAN 0>
<SPAN 1>to the «OLPORTAL’s» token sale public offer</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>Publication and entry into force data: August 01, 2018</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>Non-disclosure agreement</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4>The company exists under the law of Singapore and is called OLCF Corporation PTE. </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>LTD (hereinafter “the Company”), of the ﬁrst part, and the token purchaser (hereinafter “the Investor”) in accordance with the «OLPORTAL’s» token sale public offer (hereinafter “the Offer”), have signed the present non-disclosure agreement (hereinafter “the Agreement”) as follows below.</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>1. General provisions and deﬁnitions</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>1.1. The Company represents the Disclosing Party under the Agreement.</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>1.2. The Investor represents the Receiving Party under the Agreement.</SPAN 8>
<SPAN 9>1.3. An Agent of the Investor is an authorized person of the investor who has access to the Proprietary Information.</SPAN 9>
<SPAN 10>1.4. The Proprietary Information is any information of the Company marked as «Commercial Secret» or «Conﬁdential» with actual or potential commercial value by virtue of the fact third-parties are unfamiliar with it, submitted to the Investor by the Company in written form by documents transmission, including the electronic transmission of documents secured from unauthorized access to the transmitted information, the information related to business or ﬁnance plans and strategies including, without limitation information about markets, ﬁnancial documents, ﬁnancial statements and accounting (except for cases deﬁned by law), contractual relationships, pricing and marketing of goods (works and services), technical information, commercial secrets, know-how, research, production schedules, concepts, intellectual activity property (which includes discoveries, inventions, rationalization proposals, utility models, constructions, industrial models that are non-proprietary for some reasons, computer software, databases, logotypes scratches that are non-registered for some reasons).</SPAN 10>
<SPAN 11>The Proprietary Information does not include any publicly available information, the access to which was provided to the third parties by the Company without limitations, or in case if this information became public through no fault of the Investor in force of other circumstances, to relation of which the Investor can prove that the Investor has already possessed this information by the time when the Company provided it, or this information contained no conﬁdentiality preservation obligations.</SPAN 11>
<SPAN 12>The information also cannot be called Proprietary in cases where the Investor can prove that it was created by himself or herself without resorting to the Proprietary Information.</SPAN 12>
<SPAN 13>The Agreement does not regulate personal information security and the transmission of the information related to bank secrecy.</SPAN 13>
<SPAN 14>2. Subject of the agreement</SPAN 14>
<SPAN 15>2.1. Obligations of parties to secure the Proprietary Information under the terms indicated in the Agreement constitute the subject of the agreement.</SPAN 15>
<SPAN 16>2.2. The Company discloses the Proprietary Information concerning acquisition and further use and realization of OL-tokens during «OLPORTAL» ICO to the Investor, including individual preferences provided to the Investor at any stage of transactions at the time of ICO in accordance with the provisions of the Offer and accompanying documents including terms of smart-contracts, according to which the investor acquires OL-tokens.</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>3. Conﬁdentiality restrictions</SPAN 17>
<SPAN 18>3.1. The Investor is authorized to grant access to the proprietary information only to those parties who require access to the proprietary information in realizing the investors’ rights under the Offer in order to achieve the provision of the Proprietary Information, are obliged not to disclose the Proprietary Information and informed about the fact of the conclusion of the Agreement. </SPAN 18><SPAN 19>The Investor is obliged to provide the list of Investor’s Agents who have received access to the Proprietary Information.</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>3.2. Non-performance of terms of section 3.1. of the Agreement causes the termination of access to the Proprietary Information and provides the Company with the right to refuse unilaterally from performing any agreements along with the Offer, concluded with the Investor, according to which the Investor shall procure or procured the access to the Proprietary Information.</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21>3.3. Should the controversy between conﬁdentiality clauses in the Agreements signed by the parties appear, according to which the Investor shall procure or procured the access to the Proprietary Information and according to the terms of the Agreement, the conditions stated in the Agreement shall prevail.</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22>3.4. The Investor is obliged to keep, withhold, and hold any conﬁdential information, take measures, which are greater than or equal to measures which the Investor takes to protect his or her own conﬁdential information, to secure the Proprietary Information.</SPAN 22>
<SPAN 23>3.5. The Investor and his or her authorized Agents with access to the conﬁdential information are obliged to use the Proprietary Information for the purpose of the conﬁdential information provision and not to apply it for any other purposes.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>3.6. The Investor shall be entitled to make copies, abstracts, memoranda, or other documents (including documents made by mechanical or electronic means) related to the conﬁdential information, which shall also be marked as «Commercial Secret» and/or «Conﬁdential» only to the extents that are necessary for the conﬁdential information achievement. </SPAN 24><SPAN 25>The Investor shall provide the true recording of all copies and places where the duplicates copies of the conﬁdential information are kept, and access limitation to the speciﬁed copies, abstracts, memoranda, and other documents to third-parties except for his or her authorized Agents, according to the section 3.1. of the Agreement.</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>3.7. The Investor shall provide constant and secure information storage not allowing to obtain the data access by any persons except for Investor’s authorized Agents.</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27>3.8. Should facts of conﬁdential information disclosure to the third parties be detected, the Investor shall immediately inform the Company about the facts and measures taken to reduce losses.</SPAN 27>
<SPAN 28>4. Disclosure requirements</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>4.1. Should the Investor be obliged to disclose the conﬁdential information as prescribed by law, the Investor agrees and undertakes to inform the Company in written form immediately with the speciﬁcation of the person requesting the conﬁdential information. </SPAN 29><SPAN 30>The Investor agrees and undertakes to disclose the information within the limits deﬁned by legislation.</SPAN 30>
<SPAN 31>5. Restrictions of the rights</SPAN 31>
<SPAN 32>5.1. All information disclosed to the Investor by the Company in any form shall be and remain the property of the Company. </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>Documents and any copies of them, abstracts, memoranda, or other documentation shall be immediately returned to the Company or destroyed at the written request of the Company.</SPAN 33>
<SPAN 34>5.2. The Company reserves the right to conduct the analysis of the conﬁdential information protection measures taken by the Investor. </SPAN 34><SPAN 35>Should the denial to provide the information about measures taken for the conﬁdential information protection, received by the Investor, or detection of insufﬁcient measures taken to protect the conﬁdential information, the company is authorized to deny entrusting the conﬁdential information or refuse to fulﬁll the obligations of any agreements concluded between the parties unilaterally, according to which the Investor shall procure or procured accesses to the conﬁdential information.</SPAN 35>
<SPAN 36>6. Liability of the parties</SPAN 36>
<SPAN 37>6.1. The party who fails to encompass its obligations under the Agreement is obliged to recoup the other party for damages caused by disclosure or misuse of the conﬁdential information. </SPAN 37><SPAN 38>The damages shall be recouped according to Singapore legislation.</SPAN 38>
<SPAN 39>7. Duration of the agreement</SPAN 39>
<SPAN 40>7.1. The Agreement shall enter into force as soon as it has been accepted by the Investor and also shall be effective during 5 (ﬁve) years from the termination of the effective period of the Offer, so that the Investor shall fulﬁll its obligations of conﬁdentiality for 5 (ﬁve) years following the expiration of the Agreement or Offer.</SPAN 40>
<SPAN 41>8. Information transmission</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42>8.1. No party is allowed to assign fully or partially or otherwise transfer its rights and liabilities under the Agreement without receiving the prior written consent of the other party thereto.</SPAN 42>
<SPAN 43>9. Other terms and conditions</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>9.1. Disputes relating to the agreement between the parties should be subject to Singapore International Arbitration Centre’s review (SIAC).</SPAN 44>
<SPAN 45>9.2. The Agreement is published under the unique domain name olportal.</SPAN 45><SPAN 46>ai at the company site on the Internet.</SPAN 46>
<SPAN 47>9.3. The Agreement is drawn up and published in the English language. </SPAN 47><SPAN 48>In case of the necessity of translation into another language, the Investor agrees and undertakes to carry out the translation into a required language by using his or her own resources and at his or her own expense. </SPAN 48><SPAN 49>Should there be any discrepancies between the English version of the text of the Agreement and any other version of the text translated into the required language, the text of the Agreement written originally in English shall govern.</SPAN 49>
<SPAN 50>9.4. The Agreement constituents the integral part of the Offer. </SPAN 50><SPAN 51>All provisions of the current version of the Offer apply to the relations of the parties of the Agreement.</SPAN 51><SPAN 52>The Agreement constituents the integral part of the Offer. </SPAN 52><SPAN 53>All provisions of the current version of the Offer apply to the relations of the parties of the Agreement.</SPAN 53>
<SPAN 54>COMPANY DETAILS</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>The name: OLCF CORPORATION PTE. </SPAN 55><SPAN 56>LTD.</SPAN 56>

<SPAN 59>Director: Artem Evdokimov</SPAN 59>
<SPAN 60>Website of OLPORTAL - https://olportal.ai</SPAN 60>
<SPAN 61>Contact us: support@olportal.ai</SPAN 61>

guidance.inspection: Reconstruct the operative protected-information definition from its preamble, incorporated definitions, alternatives, exclusions, form rules, and linked conditions. Test explicit identification as a universal proposition: marking or identification required for every protected item supports it; reasonable-understanding, circumstances, nature, or automatic-inclusion alternatives oppose it; mere absence of a marking rule is unresolved. For technical-only scope, use subjects within the controlling definition, not unrelated recitals or uses; protected business, financial, marketing, personnel, customer, or operational information opposes it. Express oral or verbal coverage supports oral inclusion even when later confirmation is required. Cite all independently responsive definition members and necessary governing language.

For each proposition locate an operative permission, exclusion, restriction, ownership rule, or reservation, then verify actor, object, recipient class, purpose, polarity, conditions, and necessary preamble. Independent development and lawful third-party receipt are distinct exceptions; neither substitutes for the other. Sharing requires an operative disclosure or access rule, with any incorporated recipient definition: employees support employee sharing, named nonemployee advisers, agents, consultants, contractors, counsel, or representatives support third-party sharing, and an exclusive employee-only rule opposes nonemployee sharing. Limited use requires a use restriction; copying, disclosure, access, or a limited license alone does not decide it. No-licensing may follow from express no-right, no-license, ownership, or reservation language; access or evaluation alone is unresolved. Preserve independently responsive clauses.

Decide return or destruction, copy creation, post-disposition retention, and survival separately while reading each clause with its lead-in, trigger, alternatives, exceptions, and cross-references. Return-or-destruction requires a mandatory disposition tied in the operative rule to termination, expiration, completion, conclusion, rejection, or another stated end of the relationship; do not transfer a separate termination event into a request-only duty. Copy permission must be affirmative, including a necessary-purpose exception; a prohibition conditioned on later consent opposes permission, and archival persistence is not copy creation. Post-disposition possession requires an express retention exception; an unqualified duty covering all material or copies opposes it even when request-triggered. Survival requires an identified obligation continuing beyond an end event. Preserve all governing and independently responsive evidence.

Inspect the complete document separately for agreement secrecy, compelled-disclosure notice, personnel non-solicitation, and reverse engineering. Agreement secrecy is supported by an operative prohibition covering the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations; definition-based coverage also requires the linked secrecy duty. Compelled-disclosure notice requires legal, regulatory, governmental, judicial, subpoena, or administrative compulsion linked to notice, information, or consultation for the disclosing party; a bare disclosure exception is unresolved. Non-solicitation requires an operative restriction concerning the disclosing party's employees, officers, consultants, agents, or comparable personnel, with its lead-in, duration, consent terms, and exceptions; securities proxy solicitation and unrelated customer restrictions do not qualify. Reverse engineering requires an operative reverse-engineering, decompilation, or disassembly prohibition concerning protected information or an embodying object. Absence remains NotMentioned; preserve all responsive evidence.

<PAST H1:p>Recipient hereby acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure or use of Confidential Information could cause irreparable harm and significant injury which may be difficult to ascertain. </PAST H1:p><PAST H1:q>Accordingly, Recipient agrees that the Company shall have the right to seek and obtain immediate injunctive relief from breaches of this Agreement, in addition to any other rights and remedies it may have.</PAST H1:q>
<PAST H1:r>This Agreement shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of California as they apply to contracts entered into and wholly to be performed in the State of California. </PAST H1:r><PAST H1:s>The federal and state courts within the State of California shall have exclusive jurisdiction to adjudicate any dispute arising out of this Agreement.</PAST H1:s>
